Discover the inside story of Red Bull Racing with Christian Horner’s candid and uncompromising autobiography, a gripping, behind-the-scenes account of life at pinnacle of Formula 1.

For over twenty years Christian Horner built and ran Red Bull Racing, transforming a rookie team acquired for £1 into one of the leading forces in Formula 1. Inspired by the company’s unofficial motto, ‘No Risk, No Fun’, Horner’s Red Bull rewrote the rulebook, broke longstanding records, won fourteen World Championship titles and created a global sporting franchise now worth billions.

Now in his frank and unflinching autobiography, Drive, Christian tells his story for the first time.

From his childhood passion for speed to a career as a racing driver, to his appointment as the youngest team principal in F1 history, Christian exposes the incredible pressures of that role, the psychological demands negotiated during each race, and the instinctive decision-making required to win (and win again) in a sport of maximum risk with the very finest of margins.

Offering a unique and unfiltered perspective on the sport, Horner captures the intense drama and high personal cost of pushing a team to the very limits of performance. He talks about the shock upsets, rivalries and private challenges he faced, as well as the collaborations that underpinned his success: with figures from Dietrich Mateschitz to Bernie Ecclestone, with drivers including Max Verstappen, Sebastien Vettel and Daniel Riccardo, and most importantly with his wife Geri.

More than anything, he reveals the vision, the ambition, and the sacrifices required to lead a team to greatness.

Packed with gripping stories and unprecedented insights, Drive is the must-read Formula 1 autobiography for fans who want a whole new perspective on the inner workings of F1 and Red Bull Racing.

© Christian Horner 2026 (P) Penguin Audio 2026
